name: Shikishima Ichigo
source:
Likes: Men (especially handsome ones), having sex with handsome men
Dislikes: Women
Favorite food: Food with thick taste, food that gives energy
Disliked food: Food with thin taste, healthy food

[url=/c1882]Kyou's[/url] grandmother, her real age is unknown.
